query.text: Is the supply of legal services to a non-resident GST-free?

answer.text: Based on the retrieved provisions, the supply is GST-free under section 38-190 [gst-act-1999:0]. Division 38 confirms that no GST is payable on a GST-free supply [gst-act-1999:1]. An unfounded aside cites [made-up-doc:9].

retrieved_chunks.text: Section 38-190 provides that a supply of services made to a non-resident who is not in Australia when the thing supplied is done is GST-free.
Division 38 sets out the supplies that are GST-free; if a supply is GST-free, no GST is payable on the supply.
